The '''Valgauth system''',<ref name="EAOC" /> also known as the '''V1 and V2 binary star system''',<ref name="The Yard of Opportunity" /> was a [[Binary star/Legends|binary]] [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Nojic sector/Legends|Nojic sector]] of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained three [[Planet/Legends|planets]], including [[Valgauth/Legends|Valgauth]], the only life-sustaining planet in the system.<ref name="The Yard of Opportunity" />
